covers: How this frontend talks to the Express eSIM backend ('E-SIM backend' sibling repo): BFF layer, backend client, env wiring.
why_bff_exists: nginx in production proxies the ENTIRE /api/* prefix to the Express backend, including paths Next never claims. Next route handlers used to live at src/app/api/** and were silently unreachable in prod (Express 404 'Cannot GET ...'). Fixed 2026-08-13 by git-mv'ing all 20 route handlers to src/app/bff/**. See f003, f028.

core_module.getBackendApiUrl(): process.env.BACKEND_API_URL ?? NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL ?? 'https://esim.uplisoft.com/api' (default applies in ALL envs incl. next dev)
core_module.backendFetch<T>(path, {method,body,token: cache:'no-store'; sets Authorization: Bearer <token> when given; unwraps envelope {status,data,error,message}; returns BackendResult<T> = {ok:true,data} | {ok:false,status,message,payload?}
core_module.error_collapse: any fetch throw or JSON parse failure -> {ok:false,status:502,message:'We could not reach the eSIM service. Please try again.'}
core_module.supported_methods: GET | POST | PUT | DELETE (PUT added for billing-address PUT in the profile phase)

bff_routes.pattern: each route.ts is a thin proxy: parse request -> backendFetch()/callWithSession() -> map to NextResponse.json({status,data|error})
bff_routes.trap: src/app/checkout/return/route.ts and src/app/account/topup/return/route.ts are OUTSIDE app/bff (they are page-adjacent return handlers reached directly by Pokpay redirect, not browser fetch calls).

public_vs_authenticated_data.public_catalog: Server Components call src/services/server-packages.ts -> backendFetch('/packages') straight to backend origin, no cookies.
public_vs_authenticated_data.browser_catalog: Client code calls src/services/packages.ts -> fetch('/bff/packages') -> same shape via mapPackagesPayload() shared with server path (f023).

env_vars.BACKEND_API_URL: server-only override of backend base URL, e.g. for local dev against a local backend
env_vars.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL: fallback used if BACKEND_API_URL unset; becomes public if set (NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefix)
env_vars.note: Never read/copy actual values from .env.local or .env.production into feedAI.

mobile_coupling_constraint: velocity-eSim mobile app has https://esim.uplisoft.com/api baked into shipped builds (EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL) and api.uplisoft.com does not resolve, so /api can never be repointed at this Next app — this is a hard, load-bearing constraint on any future routing change (f028).
